Pixel OS v2.1.8 — Pure Retail Google PixelOS Stable Update for Realme X2 Pro (RMX1931)
• QTI IMS / VoLTE / SMS-over-IP / Dual-SIM Stack & Google Dialer Compatibility: integrated full Qualcomm IMS/DPM/QCRIL stack (org.codeaurora.ims, vendor.qti.imsrcs, QtiTelephonyService, qcrilmsgtunnel, dpmserviceapp, CarrierConfigRes, Android 17 libgui_shim.so, and com.google.android.dialer.support.jar) so VoLTE/ViLTE calls, outgoing SMS, incoming OTPs on Jio 4G/5G, and DSDS Dual-SIM work out of the box with zero Google Dialer unsupported device banner
• Banking & UPI App Stability (PhonePe / zDefend): retail user-build Zygote initialization (ro.debuggable=0, zero JDWP threads), early-init Bionic property parity, zero /data/adb bind-mounts in /proc/self/mountinfo, sysconfig Google Photos unlimited backup routing, and per-UID Settings.Global/Secure ADB/Developer Options isolation
• Home Screen Double-Tap to Lock Fix (Binder.clearCallingIdentity in SamuraiPlatformSigBridge) + Optical UDFPS Calibration & Compact Wireless Patch OTA
